repo.description:
### Impact

The `MessageBus.publish` call for `/web_hook_events/<id>` in `Jobs::RedeliverWebHookEvents` did not pass `group_ids`, leaving the channel readable by any authenticated user (or anonymous user on instances where `login_required` is disabled). Webhook IDs are sequential integers and trivially enumerable.

The published payload was the full `AdminWebHookEventSerializer` JSON - request URL, request headers, request body, response headers, and response body - so a non-staff subscriber could receive webhook contents that may include private post bodies, user PII, or response data from third-party endpoints they are not authorized to see.

The leak is triggered by webhook redeliveries, which are queued through the admin "redeliver"/"redeliver failed" UI and processed by the `RedeliverWebHookEvents` scheduled job. The sibling publisher in `Jobs::EmitWebHookEvent` was already restricted to the staff group and emitted a minimal payload; the redelivery path was not.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to the patched version.
repo.summary: Prevent webhook payload disclosure on event redelivery
